toppers.name: Veda Chichkar
toppers.quote:
Nikhilesh Bhatkar Sir यांनी प्रत्येक संकल्पना सोप्या पद्धतीने समजावून सांगितली. नियमित सराव, महत्त्वाच्या प्रश्नांची तयारी आणि Sir यांच्या मार्गदर्शनामुळे मला हा उत्कृष्ट निकाल मिळवता आला.

Sir यांनी दिलेल्या वैयक्तिक मार्गदर्शनाबद्दल आणि सतत प्रोत्साहनाबद्दल मनापासून धन्यवाद!

toppers.name: Shatakshi Khatu
toppers.quote:
I feel proud to have scored 56/60 in Mathematics and 58/60 in Science! 🏆

Joining Nikhilesh Bhatkar Learning Academy was a great decision. Sir's teaching style is simple, interesting, and easy to understand. He gives special attention to every student and ensures that our doubts are cleared properly.

Regular tests, question-solving practice, and valuable exam tips helped me prepare confidently for my examinations. The supportive learning environment motivated me to give my best in both subjects.

🙏 Thank you, Sir, for helping me improve my knowledge and achieve such wonderful results!

toppers.name: Shivam Gurav
toppers.quote:
Scoring 83 marks in Mathematics was a proud moment for me! 🎉

The teaching at Nikhilesh Bhatkar Learning Academy helped me understand difficult concepts easily. Sir explained every topic clearly, solved problems step by step, and guided us with regular practice and exam-oriented preparation.

The personal attention and constant motivation helped me improve my confidence and perform better in the HSC Board Examination.

🙏 Thank you, Nikhilesh Bhatkar Sir, for your valuable guidance and support!

toppers.name: Yuga Kolvankar
toppers.quote:
I'm extremely happy to have scored 97 marks in Mathematics and 95 marks in Science! 💯🏆

My journey at Nikhilesh Bhatkar Learning Academy has been a wonderful learning experience. Nikhilesh Bhatkar Sir explained every concept in a simple and easy-to-understand way. Regular practice, personal guidance, doubt-solving sessions, and exam-oriented preparation helped me achieve these excellent marks.

Sir's teaching methods made difficult topics easier and boosted my confidence to perform well in the board examination.

🙏 A heartfelt thank you to Nikhilesh Bhatkar Sir for his continuous support, motivation, and guidance!
